description: This file defines the IPVS (IP Virtual Server) data structures, constants, and methods for managing IPVS services and destinations via netlink sockets, including creating, updating, deleting, and querying services and real servers.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents an IPVS virtual service with address, protocol, port, firewall mark, scheduling options, flags, timeout, netmask, address family, PE name, and statistics.

classes.name: SvcStats
classes.description: Holds statistics for an IPVS service, including connections, packets, bytes, CPS, BPS, and PPS metrics.

classes.name: Destination
classes.description: Represents an IPVS real server destination with address, port, weight, connection flags, thresholds, connection counts, and statistics.

classes.name: DstStats
classes.description: Type alias for SvcStats, used for destination statistics.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration for IPVS timeouts, including TCP, TCP Fin, and UDP timeouts.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: Provides methods to manage IPVS services and destinations via netlink sockets within a specific namespace.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new IPVS handle in the specified network namespace path.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the IPVS handle and releases resources.

methods.name: IsServicePresent
methods.description: Checks if a specific IPVS service exists.

methods.name: NewDestination
methods.description: Creates a new real server destination for a service.

methods.name: UpdateDestination
methods.description: Updates an existing real server destination.

methods.name: GetDestinations
methods.description: Retrieves all destinations for a specific service.

methods.name: GetService
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific IPVS service.
